title: N.Y. General Obligations Law § 5-1109 — written irrevocable offers
shortTitle: N.Y. General Obligations Law § 5-1109 — written irrevo…
summary: The statute reproduced in the casebook addresses signed assurances of irrevocability beyond the UCC merchant provision.
notes: The quoted provision excepts offers governed by UCC § 2-205 and otherwise addresses an offer in a writing signed by the offeror or agent that states it is irrevocable for a period or until a time. Absence of consideration for that assurance does not make the offer revocable during the period. A writing stating irrevocability without a period is construed to use a reasonable time. This is the text reproduced by the 2023 casebook, not a current legislative verification.
